title: Area Business Manager - Hematology/Oncology- Raleigh, NC
description: Job title:  Area Business Manager - Hematology/Oncology- Raleigh, NCLocation: Remote (Geography: Raleigh, NC)About the JobThe Oncology Area Business Manager (ABM) is accountable for achieving annual sales objectives for a defined territory through the development, maintenance and enhancement of key customer relationships. Responsibilities include development and implementation of effective territory planning and leveraging Sanofi resources effectively.  Utilization of effective selling techniques and marketing strategies to create and expand product understanding and appropriate patient identification are also a must.Develop and utilize a business plan aligned with marketing strategies through territory analysis, cross-functional collaboration and customer insights (updated quarterly).Implement business plans through leveraging all appropriate resources, both human and physical, with Hematologists and Oncologists and other appropriate key customers.Develop as product, disease state and marketplace expert. Effectively communicate and position product information to customers in order to successfully promote the appropriate use of the Sanofi oncology portfolio within territory.Work closely with all field partners, including, but not limited to Oncology Transplant Network Manager (ONM) as necessary to ensure strategy pull through from Key IDNs/System, Reimbursement, Account, other Sanofi ABMs and Medical (as appropriate).Complete call reporting, business plan updates and expense reports, and operate within all Pharma compliance guidelines.Effective account targeting and time management.Attend training sessions as required and conventions and symposia, as necessary.Complete all fleet safety training and maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.About SanofiWe’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.Main ResponsibilitiesDevelop and utilize a business plan aligned with marketing strategies through territory analysis, cross-functional collaboration and customer insights (updated quarterly).Implement business plans through leveraging all appropriate resources, both human and physical, with Hematologists and Oncologists and other appropriate key customers.Develop as product, disease state and marketplace expert. Effectively communicate and position product information to customers in order to successfully promote the appropriate use of the Sanofi Genzyme oncology portfolio within territory.Work closely with all field partners as necessary to ensure strategy pull through from Key IDNs/System, Reimbursement, Key Accounts, other ABMs and Medical (as appropriate).Complete call reporting, business plan updates and expense reports, and operate within all Pharma compliance guidelines.Effective account targeting and time management.Attend training sessions as required and conventions and symposia, as necessary.Complete all fleet safety training and maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.About YouBasic Qualifications: BA/BS degree from an accredited school required. Focus in business or life science preferred.2+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience, or relevant professional business or healthcare-related experience.Preferred qualifications:Minimum two years of Oncology/Hematology sales experience OR one year previous Sanofi Oncology/Transplant sales experience.Ability to think, plan, and act strategicallyEffective oral and written communication skillsUp to 2 years successful experience in the sale of chemotherapeutic agents or bio-tech products preferredWorking knowledge of and familiarity with the hospital and cancer center environment preferred.Driving a company car in a safe manner to daily meetings and appointments is required Why Choose Us? Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.Sanofi US Services and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity employers comm

title:
【Alexion Japan】Snowflake Data Platform
                                        
                                        
 Tokyo, Japan
description: Role OverviewThe Principal Data Architect – APJ Snowflake Data Platform will provide technical architecture leadership for the design, evolution, and governance of the APJ enterprise data platform.This role will define the target architecture and technical standards for a scalable, secure, and governed data ecosystem centered on Snowflake, supporting enterprise data engineering, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and AI use cases across APJ.The Principal Data Architect will work closely with Data Engineers, BI and Analytics teams, business stakeholders, and global technology teams to translate business and data requirements into sustainable enterprise architecture.This is not only an advisory architecture role. The successful candidate is expected to have deep hands-on Snowflake expertise and be able to review technical designs, challenge engineering decisions, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide practical architectural guidance.Key Responsibilities1. Snowflake Platform ArchitectureDefine and evolve the target architecture for the APJ Snowflake data platform.Design scalable architecture patterns for enterprise data ingestion, transformation, storage, consumption, and analytics.Establish architectural principles for database, schema, warehouse, and data-layer design.Define architecture supporting BI, Advanced Analytics, Data Science, and AI workloads.Ensure architecture decisions balance scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost.2. Enterprise Data ArchitectureDefine common architectural patterns for integrating major enterprise data domains.Establish data-layer and data-modeling principles across source, transformation, and consumption layers.Define reusable architectural patterns that can be adopted across APJ markets.Guide the design of trusted and reusable enterprise data products.Ensure local market requirements can be accommodated without unnecessary architectural fragmentation.3. Snowflake Security & Access ArchitectureDefine Snowflake security and access-control architecture.Establish principles for role-based access control and appropriate separation of responsibilities.Partner with Security and Identity teams on enterprise access requirements.Provide architecture guidance for secure handling of sensitive commercial and customer data.Snowflake role design and security-related approvals are already among the architecture topics documented internally.4. Data Integration & Transformation ArchitectureDefine architectural standards for data ingestion and transformation using Fivetran and dbt.Establish patterns for source-to-Snowflake integration.Define scalable approaches for ELT and transformation architecture.Guide engineering teams on reusable dbt models and data-layer design.Review pipeline and transformation designs for architectural consistency.5. Architecture Governance & Design AuthorityServe as a technical design authority for major APJ data platform initiatives.Lead architecture and solution design reviews.Review technical proposals and identify architecture risks, dependencies, and technical debt.Define and maintain architecture standards, principles, and reusable patterns.Ensure new data solutions align with the APJ target architecture.Partner with engineering teams to move from architecture design to practical implementation.6. Platform Resilience & Operational ArchitectureDefine architectural principles for platform resilience, data protection, and recoverability.Partner with relevant technology teams on business continuity and disaster recovery requirements.Identify architectural risks and recommend improvements to platform resilience.Disaster Recovery for Snowflake has also been an active internal architecture topic.7. AI-Ready Data ArchitectureDefine a data architecture capable of supporting AI/ML and Generative AI workloads.Establish architectural patterns for governed consumption of enterprise data by AI applications.Work with Data Science and AI teams to ensure the underlying data platform supports emerging AI requirements.Evaluate how Snowflake capabilities can be incorporated into the broader APJ data and AI architecture.Internal discussions also reference the use of Snowflake for AI-related development and scaling data capabilities. Required QualificationsSnowflake ExpertiseDeep hands-on experience with Snowflake is mandatory, including:Enterprise Snowflake architecture and solution designData warehouse and analytical data architectureSnowflake security and access architectureAdvanced SQLData modelingPerformance and scalability considerationsProduction troubleshootingData integration architectureData Engineering & ArchitectureStrong knowledge and practical experience in:dbtFivetranModern ELT/ETL architectureEnterprise Data WarehousingData ModelingData IntegrationData QualityData GovernanceGit-based development and CI/CD conceptsCloud data architectureThe candidate should be technically strong enough to challenge and guide Principal/Senior Data Engine
